NEON HARBOR
A fictional demo screenplay. All people, places, brands and events are invented.

INT. KESTREL DEPOT - NIGHT

JACK paces beside a crate of prop guns. MARA cracks open a ZestPop from the fridge.
Rain hammers the skylights. A phone buzzes with the made-up song "Static Bloom".

MARA
We move at midnight.

JACK
Not in this storm.

EXT. GREYFERN PIER - NIGHT

A Halcyon flatbed truck skids through standing water as MARA and JACK sprint for the ferry.
A harbor chase erupts — stunt drivers slide across the wet asphalt while a storm
surge rocks the pier. The ferry's engine screams.

EXT. MERIDIAN ROOF - DAY

JILL rigs a stunt rigging explosion for the stunt team as a Kestrel-9 helicopter circles overhead.
A drone shot sweeps the skyline — VFX will extend the skyline at sunset.
